label: HeiLivCa
population: 50 waitlisted patients. TACE + sorafenib vs TACE + placebo.
result: Progression occurred in 7 patients per arm. Time to progression HR 1.11 (95% CI 0.39–3.16). Severe treatment-related events occurred in 50% vs 16%.
summary: Progression occurred in 7 patients per arm. Time to progression HR 1.11 (95% CI 0.39–3.16). Severe treatment-related events occurred in 50% vs 16%.
caution: Small blinded trial. No demonstrated gain in time to transplant or tumor control.
shortCaution: Small blinded trial. No demonstrated gain in time to transplant or tumor control.
author: Hoffmann

label: Kulik
population: 20 patients analyzed. Y90 + sorafenib vs Y90 alone before transplant.
result: 17/20 received a graft. Time to transplant was similar. Biliary complications occurred in 4/8 vs 0/9 recipients.
summary: 17/20 received a graft. Time to transplant was similar. Biliary complications occurred in 4/8 vs 0/9 recipients.
caution: Small randomized safety pilot. Postoperative event counts include only recipients.

label: Abdelrahim
population: Houston Methodist. TACE + sorafenib vs TACE alone in a beyond-Milan subgroup of 12 vs 24 recipients.
result: Mean explant necrosis was 69.6% vs 43.8% (P=.03). Five-year disease-free survival was 100% vs 67.2% (P=.07).
summary: Mean explant necrosis was 69.6% vs 43.8% (P=.03). Five-year disease-free survival was 100% vs 67.2% (P=.07).
caution: Milan grouping incorporated explant findings. Recipient selection prevents estimation of waitlist dropout.
shortCaution: Milan grouping incorporated explant findings. Recipient selection prevents estimation of waitlist dropout.
